Contract ManageCashDeskCRUDService::createCashDesk(id: Integer,name: String,isopened: Boolean): Boolean {
	definition:
		existingCashDesk: CashDesk = CashDesk.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id),
		isCreate: Boolean = if existingCashDesk.oclIsUndefined() 
		then true 
		else false 
		endif 
	precondition:
		id.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		name.oclIsTypeOf(String) and
		isopened.oclIsTypeOf(Boolean) and
		CashDesk.allInstance()->isUnique(o: CashDesk|o.Id)
	postcondition:
		if isCreate 
		then let newCd: CashDesk in
		newCd.oclIsNew() and
		CashDesk.allInstance()->includes(newCd) and
		newCd.Id = id and
		newCd.Name = name and
		newCd.IsOpened = isopened and
		result = isCreate 
		else result = isCreate 
		endif 
}
